title: Public data openness and venture capital investments
title_zh: 公共数据开放与风险投资
title_primary: 公共数据开放与风险投资
title_secondary: Public data openness and venture capital investments
authors: Yixuan Sun
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates the impact of public data openness (PD) on venture capital investments. Our research design provides new evidence on how public data, as digital public goods, can serve as a policy instrument in public governance to promote venture capital investments by boosting regional trust and improving the business credit environment, both theoretically and empirically. We use data from 291 prefecture-level cities from 2009 to 2021 to examine the adoption of online public data platforms by local public sectors in China’s pilot cities. Using staggered Difference-in-Differences (DID) analyses, we find that public data platforms significantly increase the number of city-level venture capital investments. Our findings are also robust to a series of tests and checks for endogeneity, including dynamic DID, synthetic DID, matching, poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood estimation, alternative measures of VC, exclusion of other policies’ impacts, Bacon-Decomposition and Callaway and Sant’Anna estimator, and machine learning techniques. In additional analysis, we also verify that public data openness helps mitigate regional investment imbalances in venture capital. Our empirical findings indicate that public sectors should promote the openness of public data resources to generate greater positive externalities in regional development. KEYWORDS: Public data digital governance trust level venture capital investments JEL CLASSIFICATION: H70 R58 M21
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了公共数据开放（PD）对风险投资的影响。我们的研究设计从理论与实证层面提供了新证据，表明公共数据作为数字公共产品，能够通过提升区域信任水平、改善商业信用环境，成为公共治理中促进风险投资的政策工具。我们采用2009年至2021年中国291个地级市的数据，考察了试点城市地方公共部门对在线公共数据平台的采纳情况。通过交错双重差分（DID）分析，我们发现公共数据平台显著增加了城市层面的风险投资数量。该结论在一系列稳健性检验和内生性处理中依然成立，包括动态DID、合成DID、匹配法、泊松伪极大似然估计、风险投资的替代度量、排除其他政策影响、Bacon分解、Callaway与Sant'Anna估计量以及机器学习技术。进一步分析表明，公共数据开放有助于缓解区域间风险投资的不平衡。实证结果指出，公共部门应推动公共数据资源的开放，以在区域发展中产生更大的正外部性。关键词：公共数据 数字治理 信任水平 风险投资 JEL分类：H70 R58 M21

title: Interdependent Hitting Times
title_zh: 相依击中时间
title_primary: 相依击中时间
title_secondary: Interdependent Hitting Times
authors: Jaap Abbring, Yifan Yu, Victor Aguirregabiria, Alessandro Iaria, Senay Sokullu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies interdependent durations as equilibrium outcomes of a synchronization game, a continuous-time stopping game in which the incentive to stop increases when other players stop. We allow the payoffs to vary with both common shocks and observed and unobserved agent characteristics. The common shocks follow a spectrally negative Lévy process, a semiparametric process that includes Brownian motion as a special case but may also have jumps. We show that equilibrium outcomes can be represented as interdependent hitting times and use this to establish the game's nonparametric identification from data on stopping times and covariates. We develop maximum simulated likelihood and method of simulated moments estimators and evaluate their finite-sample and computational performance in Monte Carlo experiments. The results provide a tractable framework for identifying and estimating synchronization games from interdependent duration data.
abstract_zh: 本文研究同步博弈均衡结果中的相互依存持续时间，该博弈是一种连续时间停止博弈，其中当其他参与者停止时，个体停止的激励会增强。我们允许收益随共同冲击以及观测和未观测到的个体特征而变化。共同冲击遵循谱负Lévy过程，这是一种半参数过程，布朗运动是其特例，但该过程也可能包含跳跃。我们证明均衡结果可表示为相互依存的首次通过时间，并据此建立该博弈基于停止时间与协变量数据的非参数识别方法。我们开发了最大模拟似然估计量和模拟矩方法估计量，并通过蒙特卡洛实验评估其有限样本表现与计算性能。研究结果为基于相互依存持续时间数据识别和估计同步博弈提供了可操作的框架。

title: Expanded Farm Safety Net Payments Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
title_zh: 《大美丽法案》下扩大农业安全网支付
title_primary: 《大美丽法案》下扩大农业安全网支付
title_secondary: Expanded Farm Safety Net Payments Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
authors: Oranuch Wongpiyabovorn, Tayatorn Pongspikul, Alejandro Plastina, Anup Paudel, Chandan Bhattarai 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) strengthens the agricultural risk coverage (ARC) and price loss coverage (PLC) programs by aligning program parameters more closely with recent market dynamics and allows for an expansion in program acres. This study projects the increases in ARC‐County and PLC payments for corn, soybeans, and wheat under OBBBA, compared with those under the 2018 Farm Bill. Total projected program payments would increase by $4.65 billion for crop year 2025 and $1.30–$2.13 billion for crop year 2026 (depending on the relative enrollment rates), with high regional heterogeneity. JEL Classification: Q14, Q18
abstract_zh: 《一项宏大美丽法案》（OBBBA）通过使项目参数更贴近近期市场动态，强化了农业风险覆盖（ARC）和价格损失覆盖（PLC）项目，并允许扩大项目面积。本研究预测了在OBBBA下，相较于2018年农业法案，玉米、大豆和小麦的ARC-县及PLC支付额的增长情况。预计2025作物年项目总支付额将增加46.5亿美元，2026作物年将增加13亿至21.3亿美元（具体取决于相对参保率），且存在显著的区域异质性。JEL分类：Q14, Q18

title: Federal Tax Deductions and the Demand for Local Public Goods
title_zh: 联邦税收减免与地方公共物品需求
title_primary: 联邦税收减免与地方公共物品需求
title_secondary: Federal Tax Deductions and the Demand for Local Public Goods
authors: Brent W. Ambrose, Maxence Valentin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The US tax system allows taxpayers to deduct local taxes from their taxable incomes. Using school district referendum results, we employ a continuous treatment two-way fixed-effects framework to provide causal evidence of a positive relation between the demand for local public goods and the share of residents deducting local taxes. We find that a 1 percentage point decrease in the share of residents deducting property taxes reduces tax and bond referendum approval rates by approximately 0.97 percentage points. Because these federal tax deductions disproportionately benefit higher-income individuals, they potentially widen disparities in public service provision across jurisdictions.
abstract_zh: 美国税收制度允许纳税人从其应税收入中扣除地方税。利用学区公投结果，我们采用连续处理双向固定效应框架，为地方公共产品需求与居民地方税扣除比例之间的正相关关系提供了因果证据。研究发现，居民房产税扣除比例每下降1个百分点，税收和债券公投的通过率将降低约0.97个百分点。由于这些联邦税收扣除对高收入群体的惠及程度不成比例，它们可能加剧不同辖区之间公共服务供给的差距。

title: Energy Transitions in Regulated Markets
title_zh: 监管市场中的能源转型
title_primary: 监管市场中的能源转型
title_secondary: Energy Transitions in Regulated Markets
authors: Gowrisankaran, Gautam, Langer, Ashley, Reguant, Mar
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Natural gas has replaced coal as the dominant fuel for U.S. electricity generation. However, utilities in regulated U.S. states have retired coal more slowly than others. We build a structural model of rate-of-return regulation during an energy transition where utilities face tradeoffs between lowering costs and maintaining and using legacy capacity. A regulated utility facing carbon taxes lowers short-run coal generation 48% as much as a cost minimizer would. Thirty years after a sudden energy transition, a cost minimizer has retired 71% more coal capacity than the regulated utility. Alternative regulations may jeopardize affordability and reliability goals during energy transitions.
abstract_zh: 天然气已取代煤炭成为美国发电的主要燃料。然而，受监管的美国各州公用事业公司淘汰煤炭的速度慢于其他地区。我们构建了一个能源转型期间回报率监管的结构模型，其中公用事业公司在降低成本与维持及使用遗留产能之间面临权衡。面对碳税的受监管公用事业公司，其短期煤炭发电量降幅仅为成本最小化公司的48%。在突发能源转型30年后，成本最小化公司淘汰的煤炭产能比受监管公用事业公司多71%。替代性监管措施可能在能源转型期间危及可负担性与可靠性目标。

title: How Test Optional Policies in College Admissions Disproportionately Harm High Achieving Applicants from Disadvantaged Backgrounds
title_zh: 大学招生中的可选考试政策如何不成比例地损害来自弱势背景的高成就申请者
title_primary: 大学招生中的可选考试政策如何不成比例地损害来自弱势背景的高成就申请者
title_secondary: How Test Optional Policies in College Admissions Disproportionately Harm High Achieving Applicants from Disadvantaged Backgrounds
authors: Sacerdote, Bruce, Staiger, Douglas O., Tine, Michele
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We analyze data from one elite institution and find that test score optional policies harm the likelihood of admission for high achieving applicants from disadvantaged backgrounds. Under test optional policies, these applicants submit test scores at too low a rate; they more than double their admissions probability (from 2.9 percent to 7.2 percent) by reporting scores. Our findings suggest that, more than commonly understood, elite institutions interpret test scores in the context of an applicant’s background. Thus, availability of test scores on an application can promote rather than hinder social mobility.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一所精英院校的数据，发现考试分数可选政策损害了来自弱势背景的高成就申请者的录取机会。在考试分数可选政策下，这些申请者提交分数的比例过低；若提交分数，其录取概率将提升一倍以上（从2.9%升至7.2%）。我们的研究结果表明，精英院校在解读考试分数时，比普遍认知更注重申请者的背景信息。因此，申请材料中提供考试分数反而能促进而非阻碍社会流动性。

title: How Might Fiscal Policy Respond to the Rise of Artificial Intelligence?
title_zh: 财政政策如何应对人工智能的崛起？
title_primary: 财政政策如何应对人工智能的崛起？
title_secondary: How Might Fiscal Policy Respond to the Rise of Artificial Intelligence?
authors: Karen Dynan, Douglas Elmendorf, Louise Sheiner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Artificial intelligence will probably generate major changes in the US economy, although the nature, timing, and magnitude of those changes are highly uncertain. We analyze a set of long-term scenarios involving different combinations of faster productivity growth, greater income inequality, job displacement, and a higher capital share of income. For each scenario, we assess the implications for federal debt and potential policy responses related to faster economic growth, the distribution of income, support for workers who are laid off, and taxation and ownership of capital. Given the uncertainty surrounding AI’s economic effects, policies that are robust to different scenarios would be especially valuable.
abstract_zh: 人工智能可能会对美国经济产生重大变革，尽管这些变革的性质、时机和规模存在高度不确定性。我们分析了一系列长期情景，涉及生产率增长加快、收入不平等加剧、岗位替代以及资本收入份额上升等不同组合。针对每种情景，我们评估了其对联邦债务的影响，以及可能采取的政策应对措施，包括加快经济增长、调节收入分配、支持失业工人，以及资本税收与所有权问题。鉴于人工智能经济影响的不确定性，能够适应不同情景的稳健政策将尤为宝贵。

title: The Labor Market Impacts of GLP-1s
title_zh: GLP-1类药物对劳动力市场的影响
title_primary: GLP-1类药物对劳动力市场的影响
title_secondary: The Labor Market Impacts of GLP-1s
authors: N. Meltem Daysal, Camille JH. Fredrickson, Ida L. Kristiansen, Mircea Trandafir, Jonathan Zhang
official: 官方在线月份 2026-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of GLP-1 treatment on labor market outcomes using linked Danish administrative data and a matched stacked difference-in-differences design. We compare patients who initiate GLP-1 treatment during the first two years of Semaglutide availability to observably similar patients who initiate four years later. We find that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave by 17.3%. We estimate total fiscal benefits of GLP-1 initiation of approximately 1.3–1.5% of annual labor income per employed individual. We do not detect statistically significant or economically meaningful impacts on income, labor force participation, or employment over four years.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦关联行政数据与匹配堆叠双重差分设计，估算了GLP-1治疗对劳动力市场结果的因果影响。研究将司美格鲁肽上市前两年内开始接受GLP-1治疗的患者，与四年后开始治疗且可观测特征相似的患者进行对比。研究发现，GLP-1治疗使长期病假减少17.3%。我们估算出GLP-1治疗带来的财政总收益约为每位就业者年劳动收入的1.3%-1.5%。在四年观察期内，未发现该治疗对收入、劳动力参与率或就业产生具有统计显著性及经济意义的影响。

title: Doing good and doing well: A CAPM with complementary ESG and financial returns
title_zh: 行善与盈利：兼具ESG与财务回报互补性的CAPM模型
title_primary: 行善与盈利：兼具ESG与财务回报互补性的CAPM模型
title_secondary: Doing good and doing well: A CAPM with complementary ESG and financial returns
authors: Michael P. Carniol
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Empirical evidence shows that environmental, social, and governance (ESG) quality interacts with financial performance at the individual asset level: high-ESG firms outperform during crises and corporate social responsibility lowers systematic beta. Models with separable ESG preferences generate a greenium but no such interaction. We develop a capital asset pricing model (CAPM) with supermodular preferences over each asset’s return and ESG score. The equilibrium features an asset-specific denominator that compresses expected returns for high-ESG assets and generates a negative beta-ESG interaction, implying lower effective market sensitivity for green firms. We show that portfolio-level complementarity cannot produce this interaction, which yields a sharp test distinguishing our mechanism in the data. The model offers one rationalization of the beta-ESG interaction. We illustrate its quantitative content with four empirical studies.
abstract_zh: 实证证据表明，环境、社会和治理（ESG）质量在个体资产层面与财务绩效相互作用：高ESG企业在危机期间表现更优，且企业社会责任降低了系统性贝塔值。具有可分离ESG偏好的模型虽能产生绿色溢价，却无法解释这种相互作用。我们构建了一个资本资产定价模型（CAPM），其中包含对每项资产回报率与ESG评分的超模偏好。均衡状态下，模型呈现资产特定的分母，压缩了高ESG资产的预期回报，并产生负向的贝塔-ESG交互效应，意味着绿色企业的有效市场敏感度较低。我们证明，投资组合层面的互补性无法产生这种交互作用，这为在数据中区分我们的机制提供了一个明确的检验标准。该模型为贝塔-ESG交互效应提供了一种合理化解释。我们通过四项实证研究展示了其定量内容。

title: From static to dynamic: A phased evolution framework for multi-stakeholder collaborative governance in comprehensive land consolidation
title_zh: 从静态到动态：全域土地综合整治中多主体协同治理的分阶段演进框架
title_primary: 从静态到动态：全域土地综合整治中多主体协同治理的分阶段演进框架
title_secondary: From static to dynamic: A phased evolution framework for multi-stakeholder collaborative governance in comprehensive land consolidation
authors: Jinghui Zhao, Yanfeng Jiang, Jiangying Yao, Shude Tan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Comprehensive land consolidation (CLC) has emerged as a policy toolkit for lots of countries and regions to promote the integrated territorial governance. While multi-stakeholder collaboration is fundamental to CLC’s success, previous studies have typically adopted a static lens, neglecting the dynamic nature of stakeholder interactions and role evolution in a project’s lifecycle. To address this gap, this study develops a phased framework to unpack the dynamic collaborative mechanisms across the CLC lifecycle. Drawing on and extending the Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework, this study deconstructs the CLC process into three sequential stages: planning, implementation, and operation. Subsequently, the “Tianlifang Future Farm” in Hangzhou, China, is used as a case study to empirically examine this framework, mapping the shifting interplay and power dynamics between government, enterprises, village collectives, and farmers. Research findings reveal that effective governance hinges on stage-specific mechanisms, including a planning revision mechanism to align divergent stakeholder interests within regulatory constraints, a consensus-building mechanism to facilitate low-conflict project execution, and a market-driven mechanism to ensure long-term operational viability. However, two critical weaknesses are identified in the state-orchestrated model that could lead to the marginalization of community interest, namely structural decoupling and skewed benefit-sharing between enterprises and farmers. This study, therefore, proposes targeted policy interventions centered on institutionalized proactive engagement and diversified equity-sharing models are proposed. In sum, this study not only transcends static governance by offering a longitudinal and process-oriednted framework for collaborative land policy, but also provides actionable insights for sustainable global land consolidation initiatives.
abstract_zh: 全域土地综合整治（CLC）已成为众多国家和地区推动区域一体化治理的政策工具。尽管多方利益相关者协作是CLC成功的基础，但以往研究通常采用静态视角，忽视了项目生命周期中利益相关者互动及角色演变的动态特性。为弥补这一不足，本研究构建了一个分阶段框架，以揭示CLC全过程中的动态协作机制。借鉴并拓展制度分析与发展（IAD）框架，本研究将CLC过程解构为三个连续阶段：规划、实施与运营。随后，以中国杭州“田立方未来农场”为案例进行实证检验，描绘政府、企业、村集体与农民之间互动关系及权力动态的转变。研究发现，有效治理依赖于阶段特定机制，包括在监管约束下协调多元利益相关者诉求的规划修订机制、促进低冲突项目执行的共识构建机制，以及确保长期运营可行性的市场驱动机制。然而，国家主导模式中存在两个可能导致社区利益边缘化的关键缺陷，即结构性脱节与企业—农民间利益分配失衡。为此，本研究提出以制度化主动参与和多元化股权共享模式为核心的政策干预建议。综上，本研究不仅通过提供纵向、过程导向的协作性土地政策框架超越了静态治理视角，还为全球可持续土地整治实践提供了可操作的见解。

title: 药品集采改革、医疗负担与医疗公平——来自医院处方的微观证据
title_zh: 药品集采改革、医疗负担与医疗公平——来自医院处方的微观证据
title_primary: 药品集采改革、医疗负担与医疗公平——来自医院处方的微观证据
authors: 诸宇灵, 顾晓敏, 周黎安, 范子英
official: 官方发布 2026-07-05 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 国家组织药品集中带量采购是治理药价虚高、深化我国医药服务供给侧改革的重要切入口。本文构建了“价格冲击—行为反应—医疗费用与医疗公平结果”的统一分析框架，利用患者—医生层面的微观处方数据，基于逐步推开的17个批次的集采药品，系统考察了集采改革对药品价格和患者医疗负担的综合影响。研究发现：第一，改革的降价效应明显，药品平均降幅超过70%，且对非集采药产生了显著的溢出效应；第二，改革降低了门诊患者的医药负担，且低收入群体、农村居民等群体受益更大，起到了促进医疗公平的预期效果；第三，改革容易出现“跷跷板效应”，医院和医生的策略性反应是将药品收入的减少转嫁到其他收费项目，部分抵消了集采改革的减负效应。本文的结论证实了药品集采改革在缓解“看病贵”问题方面的积极效应，也揭示了改革对医疗服务供需方行为的潜在影响及挑战，为完善药品集采制度提供了经验证据和重要参考。

title: Property Rights, Agricultural Technology Adoption, and Investment: Experimental Evidence from Mozambique
title_zh: 产权、农业技术采纳与投资：来自莫桑比克的实验证据
title_primary: 产权、农业技术采纳与投资：来自莫桑比克的实验证据
title_secondary: Property Rights, Agricultural Technology Adoption, and Investment: Experimental Evidence from Mozambique
authors: Brudevold-Newman, Andrew, Boxho, Claire, Montalvao, Joao, O'Sullivan, Michael, Proença, Matheus
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Insecure land rights and limited access to modern inputs are often seen as key constraints on smallholder investment in Sub-Saharan Africa. This paper studies both in a three-year field experiment with women farmers in Mozambique, cross-randomizing a statutory land registration intervention with a subsidized package of agricultural inputs and climate-smart agriculture training, and eliciting willingness to pay for the package at randomized prices. Demand for registration was high, but its effects were limited: it produced only a temporary gain in perceived tenure security and did not raise willingness to pay for inputs or down-stream investment. Despite gender-targeted titling, it also did not improve women’s intra-household security or decision-making power. The input-and-training package raised input use but reduced harvests, with exploratory evidence of a shift toward a more shock-prone crop; the losses persisted even after households fully reverted to pre-program practices. Consistent with negative social learning, non-recipients with more treated network connections also reduced their adoption of climate-smart practices over time. Relaxing both constraints together produced no effects beyond either intervention alone.
abstract_zh: 不稳定的土地权利和现代投入品的有限获取常被视为撒哈拉以南非洲小农投资的关键制约因素。本文通过对莫桑比克女性农民开展为期三年的实地实验，将法定土地登记干预与补贴性农业投入品及气候智慧型农业培训进行交叉随机化处理，并在随机定价条件下测度农户对投入品组合的支付意愿。土地登记需求虽高，但其效果有限：仅带来感知土地权属保障的暂时性提升，既未提高对投入品的支付意愿，也未促进后续投资。尽管实施性别定向的土地确权，该干预仍未能改善女性在家庭内部的保障状况或决策权。投入品与培训组合虽提高了投入品使用量，却导致收成下降——探索性证据表明农户转向更易受冲击的作物品种；即便家庭完全恢复至项目前耕作模式，损失仍持续存在。与非受益者中拥有更多受干预社交网络联系的农户随时间推移减少气候智慧型实践采用的现象一致，这印证了负面社会学习效应。同时放松两类约束并未产生超越单一干预的叠加效果。

title: Changing the board game: Horizontal spillovers of gender quotas
title_zh: 改变游戏规则：性别配额的横向溢出效应
title_primary: 改变游戏规则：性别配额的横向溢出效应
title_secondary: Changing the board game: Horizontal spillovers of gender quotas
authors: Luigi Guiso, Fabiano Schivardi, Luana Zaccaria
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the effects of mandatory board gender quotas on unregulated firms that are connected to regulated ones via interlocking directorates. After the introduction of quotas, connected firms significantly increase their share of female directors relative to similar unconnected firms. The spillover effects are substantial — at least as large as the direct effects on regulated firms, challenging previous claims that quotas have no broader impact on women in business. Our results suggest that quotas indirectly broaden the supply of candidates for connected firms, along dimensions that include, but are not limited to, gender.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了强制性董事会性别配额对通过连锁董事网络与受监管企业相关联的未受监管企业的影响。配额引入后，关联企业女性董事比例相较于类似的无关联企业显著提升。这种溢出效应显著——至少与对受监管企业的直接影响相当，这挑战了先前关于配额对商界女性无更广泛影响的观点。我们的结果表明，配额间接拓宽了关联企业候选人的供给范围，其维度包括但不限于性别。

title: The Agricultural Gender Gap in Sub-Saharan Africa: Magnitude, Drivers, and Policy Directions
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业性别差距：规模、驱动因素与政策方向
title_primary: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业性别差距：规模、驱动因素与政策方向
title_secondary: The Agricultural Gender Gap in Sub-Saharan Africa: Magnitude, Drivers, and Policy Directions
authors: Donald, Aletheia, Tafere, Kibrom
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper synthesizes country-level decomposition evidence on the gender gap in agricultural productivity across Sub-Saharan Africa, identifying its major drivers and reviewing what works to close it. Gender productivity gaps range between 7 percent and 77 percent across twelve African countries, with male-managed plots yielding higher outputs than those managed by women. Although controlling for the characteristics of farmers, households and plots tends to shrink this gap, a conditional gap of 4 percent to 62 percent persists. The literature also documents an overall gender gap in agricultural production in the range of 18 percent to 61 percent. The largest driver of these gaps is women’s concentration in lower-value crops, followed by their lower use of and returns from labor. Social norms and access to land and financial resources play a crucial role in sustaining and exacerbating these gender disparities. Evidence suggests that targeted programmatic approaches to increasing women’s adoption of cash crops, enhancing their use of labor and other inputs and providing them with tailored skills and information can help close the gender gap in agricultural productivity.
abstract_zh: 本文综合了撒哈拉以南非洲地区农业生产力性别差距的国家层面分解证据，识别其主要驱动因素，并回顾了缩小该差距的有效措施。在十二个非洲国家中，性别生产力差距介于7%至77%之间，男性管理的地块产出高于女性管理的地块。尽管控制农户、家庭和地块特征后，这一差距有所缩小，但条件性差距仍维持在4%至62%之间。文献还记录了农业生产中18%至61%的总体性别差距。这些差距的最大驱动因素是女性集中于低价值作物，其次是她们对劳动力的使用较少且回报较低。社会规范以及土地和金融资源的获取在维持和加剧这些性别差异中起着关键作用。证据表明，通过有针对性的项目方法提高女性对经济作物的采用、增强其劳动力及其他投入的使用，并提供量身定制的技能和信息，有助于缩小农业生产力中的性别差距。

title: Mergers, Innovation, and Merger Policy
title_zh: 合并、创新与合并政策
title_primary: 合并、创新与合并政策
title_secondary: Mergers, Innovation, and Merger Policy
authors: Justus Haucap, Joel Stiebale
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we summarise the economic literature on the effects of mergers and acquisitions (M&As) on innovation. We primarily focus on empirical studies, but also discuss mechanisms predicted by the theoretical literature. Although the effects of mergers on innovation can be theoretically ambiguous, the vast majority of ex-post evaluations of horizontal M&As find large negative effects on innovation inputs and outputs. In contrast, vertical and other non-horizonal mergers are less likely to generate detrimental effects. We discuss a number of selected merger cases in which the European Commission raised concerns about innovation and derive some ideas and options for merger policy.

title: Peer Effects in Consideration and Preferences
title_zh: 考虑与偏好中的同伴效应
title_primary: 考虑与偏好中的同伴效应
title_secondary: Peer Effects in Consideration and Preferences
authors: Nail Kashaev, Natalia Lazzati, Ruli Xiao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a general model of discrete choice that incorporates peer effects in preferences and consideration sets. We characterize the equilibrium behavior and establish conditions under which all parts of the model can be recovered from a sequence of choices. We allow peers to affect preferences, consideration, or both. We show that these peer-effect mechanisms have different behavioral implications in the data. This allows us to recover the set and the type of connections between the agents in the network. We then use this information to recover each agent’s preferences and consideration mechanisms. These nonparametric identification results allow for general forms of heterogeneity across agents and do not rely on the variation of either exogenous covariates or the set of available options (menus). We apply our results to model expansion decisions by tea chains and find evidence of limited consideration. We simulate counterfactual predictions and show how limited consideration slows market penetration and competition.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含偏好与考虑集同群效应的离散选择一般模型。我们刻画了均衡行为特征，并建立了可从选择序列中恢复模型所有组成部分的条件。我们允许同群效应影响偏好、考虑集或两者兼有。研究表明，这些同群效应机制在数据中具有不同的行为含义，从而能够识别网络中各主体之间的连接集合与类型。基于此信息，我们进一步恢复每个主体的偏好与考虑机制。这些非参数识别结果允许主体间存在一般形式的异质性，且不依赖于外生协变量或可选方案集（菜单）的变化。我们将模型应用于茶饮连锁店的扩张决策分析，发现了有限考虑的证据。通过反事实预测模拟，我们揭示了有限考虑如何减缓市场渗透与竞争。

title: 产学研合作网络与企业突破性创新
title_zh: 产学研合作网络与企业突破性创新
title_primary: 产学研合作网络与企业突破性创新
authors: 王群勇, 张慧敏
official: 官方发布 2026-06-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 在新型举国体制框架下,如何通过产学研深度融合提升企业突破性创新能力,已成为推动我国经济高质量发展的重要议题。本文基于全球专利数据库构建产学研合作网络与企业突破性创新指标,运用因果机器学习与政策学习方法,考察产学研合作对个体企业突破性创新的影响。研究发现,产学研合作总体上显著促进企业突破性创新,优化人力资本结构、增强基础研发能力和提高信息共享程度是其主要作用渠道。由于企业资本结构、企业生产与扩张能力、企业规模与地区产业结构等因素的制约,约14.3%的企业并未从合作中获得显著创新收益,这些因素对效应异质性的解释比例达到68.2%。同时,约17.3%的合作企业存在错配现象,最优政策树策略可显著提升合作收益。本研究结论有助于深入理解产学研合作对企业突破性创新的差异化效应,对完善创新激励政策、优化企业创新合作策略以及推动创新型国家建设具有政策启示意义。

title: Public pensions and LTC insurance with family solidarity
title_zh: 家庭团结视角下的公共养老金与长期护理保险
title_primary: 家庭团结视角下的公共养老金与长期护理保险
title_secondary: Public pensions and LTC insurance with family solidarity
authors: Yukihiro Nishimura, Pierre Pestieau
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As income rises, the risk of disability in old age declines, while life expectancy increases. These correlations strengthen the case for public long-term care (LTC) insurance over public pension systems. However, this perspective shifts when considering family solidarity—specifically, the informal care provided by spouses and children to elderly relatives. When viewed through the lens of altruistic caregiving motives, the argument for social LTC insurance becomes more nuanced. The interplay between formal and informal care is a key factor in shaping optimal policy. In this paper, we demonstrate that when family members reliably provide informal care, the design of a comprehensive public LTC system depends on the existence of a private insurance and on the degree of substitutability between informal and formal care.

abstract: We consider a payment arrangement in which transfers and holdings of currency, but not of real resources, can be recorded and traced by monitoring technology. We show that this payment arrangement improves upon traditional cash payments, allowing transfers of currency among strangers, which can be interpreted as monetary loans.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一种支付安排，其中货币的转移和持有（而非实际资源）可通过监控技术进行记录和追踪。研究表明，这种支付安排优于传统的现金支付，允许陌生人之间进行货币转移，这可以理解为货币贷款。

title: Financial frictions, FX reserves, and exchange rate management with local-currency debt
title_zh: 金融摩擦、外汇储备与本地货币债务下的汇率管理
title_primary: 金融摩擦、外汇储备与本地货币债务下的汇率管理
title_secondary: Financial frictions, FX reserves, and exchange rate management with local-currency debt
authors: Sauhard Srivastava
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Emerging economy central banks often hold large FX reserves while residents carry substantial local-currency-linked external liabilities. With financial frictions creating interest parity gaps, such opposing positions imply a carry cost. In a small open economy with intermediation frictions and inherited local-currency debt, we study optimal reserve and exchange rate policies, explaining why debtor economies may retain reserves rather than netting out costly gross positions. While policy can eliminate costly intermediation by deploying reserves and appreciating the real exchange rate, doing so creates a general equilibrium revaluation effect which raises the real burden of local-currency obligations. Optimal policy retains reserves, accepting some intermediation to avoid a larger revaluation loss. This policy is time-inconsistent: a discretionary central bank prefers stronger ex-post appreciation; a time-consistent equilibrium features more reserve retention and larger interest parity gaps. Revaluation costs restrain reserve deployment; when large, optimal policy retains more reserves during disruptions than in normal times.

title: Spatial Spillovers of Conflict in Somalia
title_zh: 索马里冲突的空间溢出效应
title_primary: 索马里冲突的空间溢出效应
title_secondary: Spatial Spillovers of Conflict in Somalia
authors: Marco Alfano, Thomas Cornelissen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Conflict along transportation routes during Somalia’s al-Shabaab insurgency significantly increases maize prices at distant locations, decreasing food security, health, and education. Estimated conflict risk has strong price effects independently of realized conflict, highlighting the importance of safety concerns. A model of least-cost route choice in the presence of conflict reveals that more and shorter alternative routes to circumvent conflict can lower prices but their effectiveness diminishes as violence becomes more correlated across routes. Alternatively, securing key transportation routes would alleviate price increases. A market access approach suggests spatial spillovers of conflict also matter for prices of more general baskets of food and nonfood items. (JEL D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41)
abstract_zh: 索马里青年党叛乱期间，运输路线上的冲突显著抬高了偏远地区的玉米价格，进而削弱了粮食安全、健康与教育水平。冲突风险的估计值独立于已发生的冲突本身，对价格产生强烈影响，凸显了安全关切的重要性。基于冲突环境下最低成本路线选择模型的分析表明：增加更多且更短的替代路线以规避冲突可降低价格，但随着暴力事件在路线间的相关性增强，其效果逐渐减弱。另一种方案是保障关键运输路线的安全，这将有效缓解价格上涨。市场准入分析进一步揭示，冲突的空间溢出效应同样影响更广泛的食品与非食品类商品价格。（JEL分类号：D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41）

title: Strategic formation of production networks
title_zh: 生产网络的战略形成
title_primary: 生产网络的战略形成
title_secondary: Strategic formation of production networks
authors: Antoine Mandel, Van-Quy Nguyen, Bach Dong-Xuan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We provide a strategic model of the formation of production networks that subsumes the standard general equilibrium approach. The objective of firms in our setting is to choose their supply relationships so as to maximize their profit at the general equilibrium that unfolds. We show that this objective is equivalent to the maximization by the firms of their eigenvector centrality in the production network. As is common in network formation games based on centrality, there are multiple Nash equilibria in our setting. We have investigated the characteristics and the social efficiency of these equilibria in a stylized version of our model representing international trade networks. We show that the impact of network structure on social welfare is firstly determined by a trade-off between costs of increasing process complexity and positive spillovers on productivity induced by the diversification of the input mix. We further analyze a variant of our model that accounts for the risks of disruption of supply relationships. In this setting, we characterize how social welfare depends on the structure of the production network, the spatial distribution of risks, and the process of shock aggregation in supply chains. We finally show that simple trade policies characterized by sets of links that are either prevented or catalyzed can be a powerful equilibrium selection device.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个生产网络形成的战略模型，该模型涵盖了标准一般均衡方法。在我们的设定中，企业的目标是选择其供应关系，以在随之展开的一般均衡中最大化其利润。我们证明，这一目标等同于企业在生产网络中最大化其特征向量中心性。正如基于中心性的网络形成博弈中常见的那样，我们的设定中存在多个纳什均衡。我们已在一个代表国际贸易网络的简化模型版本中研究了这些均衡的特征及其社会效率。我们表明，网络结构对社会福利的影响首先由增加流程复杂性的成本与投入组合多样化带来的生产率正向溢出之间的权衡决定。我们进一步分析了我们模型的一个变体，该变体考虑了供应关系中断的风险。在此设定中，我们刻画了社会福利如何依赖于生产网络的结构、风险的空间分布以及供应链中冲击聚合的过程。最后，我们证明，以被阻止或被促进的链接集合为特征的简单贸易政策可以成为强大的均衡选择工具。

title: Interior optimal imprisonment under diminishing marginal disutility
title_zh: 边际负效用递减下的最优监禁刑期
title_primary: 边际负效用递减下的最优监禁刑期
title_secondary: Interior optimal imprisonment under diminishing marginal disutility
authors: Tim Friehe, Murat C. Mungan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This note revisits the important question of how fines and imprisonment should be optimally employed. In D’Antoni et al. (2022), a monotone hazard rate condition implies a corner solution for imprisonment in the observable-wealth benchmark when imprisonment disutility is linear. We show that this result is not robust to offenders facing diminishing marginal disutility of imprisonment. The optimal prison term is interior as long as the marginal disutility associated with large imprisonment terms are low and the harms from the offense are large enough to warrant imprisonment. The sentence length thus becomes a genuine policy margin rather than a boundary instrument.
abstract_zh: 本文重访了罚款与监禁如何最优运用这一重要问题。在D'Antoni等人（2022）的研究中，单调风险率条件在监禁负效用为线性时，于可观察财富基准下导致了监禁的角点解。我们证明，当罪犯面临监禁边际负效用递减时，这一结果并不稳健。只要与较长监禁期限相关的边际负效用较低，且犯罪危害足够大以至于需要监禁，最优监禁期限即为内部解。因此，刑期长度成为一个真正的政策边际，而非边界工具。

title: Interest rate misalignments and monetary policy: Evidence from U.S. states
title_zh: 利率错配与货币政策：来自美国各州的证据
title_primary: 利率错配与货币政策：来自美国各州的证据
title_secondary: Interest rate misalignments and monetary policy: Evidence from U.S. states
authors: Zo Andriantomanga, N. Kundan Kishor, Labesh Kumar
official: 官方在线 2026-04-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine whether a uniform monetary policy effectively addresses diverse state-level economic conditions in the U.S. Using quarterly data from 1989 to 2017 for 33 states, we construct state-optimal interest rates based on Taylor rule frameworks incorporating local inflation and unemployment gaps. Deviations from the federal funds rate are large, persistent, and cluster regionally. Local projections show that a 1 pp positive deviation is associated with a 0.6 pp decline in headline inflation and an increase in unemployment, with the strongest effects in non-tradable sectors. State-specific deviation shocks elicit larger and longer-lasting responses than aggregate shocks, underscoring the importance of cross-sectional heterogeneity.
